name: – After § 126 – Am 32
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: 126a. Condemns the Turkish Government’s intensified crackdown on civil society – notably on environmental rights defenders and peaceful protesters, including the recent attack on the LGBTIQ+ community – ahead of both the July NATO summit as well as COP31, through arbitrary arrests, criminal prosecutions, ill treatment and restrictions on freedom of assembly and expression; reminds the Government of Türkiye of its obligation, as a host of COP31, to facilitate the participation and protection of civil society;
